gen.title: Recall facts about proposals and ratification

cards.stem: How many amendments were originally proposed to the constitution?
cards.quote: Although 12 amendments were originally proposed, the 10 that were ratified became the Bill of Rights in 1791.

cards.stem: What did the amendments define in relation to the newly established government?
cards.quote: They defined citizens' rights in relation to the newly established government under the Constitution.

cards.stem: What did opponents charge the draft constitution would open the way to?
cards.quote: its opponents repeatedly charged that the Constitution as drafted would open the way to tyranny by the central government.

cards.stem: When were Articles 3 to 12 ratified to constitute the first 10 amendments?
cards.quote: Articles 3 to 12, ratified December 15, 1791, by three-fourths of the state legislatures
